verdict.rationale: AnyDesk's own REST API docs point to an open-source Python module with scripts and templates for building integrations against the account API. That is the closest thing to an official SDK, but it is a single-language helper module rather than a documented, versioned SDK family, and the probe found no OpenAPI spec. The CLI is a separate automation feature and earns no credit here. Missing for 10: clearly official, maintained SDKs in multiple languages, SDK reference docs and versioning, a published OpenAPI spec, and independent or hands-on confirmation that developers build against the module.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
